description: Leadership and momentum lens. Drives large org transformation through urgency, coalition, and visible wins.
name: Kotter 8-Step

phases.label: Create a Sense of Urgency
phases.plain_english: Make the need to change feel real and now.

phases.label: Build a Guiding Coalition
phases.plain_english: Assemble trusted leaders who drive the change together.

phases.label: Form a Strategic Vision
phases.plain_english: Define a clear picture of the future people can repeat.

phases.label: Enlist a Volunteer Army
phases.plain_english: Get broad buy-in beyond the leadership team.

phases.label: Enable Action by Removing Barriers
phases.plain_english: Clear obstacles so people can actually change.

phases.label: Generate Short-Term Wins
phases.plain_english: Create visible early successes to build momentum.

phases.label: Sustain Acceleration
phases.plain_english: Keep pushing. Don't declare victory too early.

phases.label: Institute Change
phases.plain_english: Anchor the change in culture, systems, and process.
